name: Stitchwork: Patched Denim
tagline: The village is the back of a well-loved denim jacket, and the Wolf is the patch hiding under one of the answers.

fonts.display: Graduate (varsity letters: chenille HXQR and +100 on bone felt with an ink felt outline) and Yellowtail (chain-stitch script: thickened, raised and lit with an SVG filter, plus a layer of link ticks)
fonts.ui: Archivo variable width: expanded 800 for buttons and the prompt rocker, condensed for enamel-pin labels and woven tags

motifs: Procedural indigo 3/1 twill with ring-dyed fades, seam roping and double copper topstitching (yoke, panel seams, waistband)
Room code as four chenille varsity letters over a curved bottom rocker carrying the join URL
Villagers as round iron-on patches with overlocked (merrowed) edges and name tapes
Enamel pins for settings, the countdown and the award; safety pins hold the QR canvas and 'Your pick'
Woven black-and-copper 'Body Double' label sewn on; the prompt is a biker-style top rocker
reveal: The Wolf's answer patch is ripped off and left hanging by one corner with torn overlock and loose threads, exposing a darker, unfaded patch-shaped ghost of denim ringed with needle holes where the embroidered Wolf patch was sewn underneath under 'It was the Wolf!' in chain-stitch script, while the real answer gets a copper-and-oxblood enamel award pin reading 'The real Maya'.
why: Mid-indigo denim keeps glare low in a dim room, while bone twill, orange chenille and gold-on-enamel give the code, answers and buttons strong contrast from 5 m. Every element is a real jacket part (patch, rocker, pin, label), so the reveal reads instantly: a patch gets torn off and the Wolf was underneath.
